novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new cross-model mechanism and translation method: the same-base barrier is proposed to be “not fundamental but a coordinate-mismatch,” repairable by “a lightweight, learnable data-space or activation-space translator.” The closest works are Transferring Linear Features Across Language Models With Model Stitching (2025), which already transfers steering vectors through affine residual-stream maps, and Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation (2026), which attributes failed cross-model subliminal transfer to model-specific steering effects; searches around “cross-model subliminal learning activation alignment,” “steering vector transfer model stitching,” and “subliminal learning translator” did not identify an equivalent attempt to produce target-aligned covert training data. Moving from those works to the activation translator is a natural but non-trivial combination rather than a new core representational principle, while the data-space translator adds a more substantive operationalization by optimizing semantically unrelated outputs for a target model’s steering-gradient signal, supporting standard rather than high novelty.
